SourceString: Tap a gap in the ring to place the piece in the middle.
A plus merges two equal neighbours into their double.
Symmetry around a plus starts a chain. Find it.
A minus lifts a piece out of the ring. Tap one.
Tap the centre to turn the lifted piece into a plus.
A full ring ends the run. Tap the breeze at the top right, then tap the ring: it clears the half nearest your tap.
